title: ChipBlocks content registry index
description: Version 1 index a user points at with an https URL (file:// only for a local test or dev). ChipBlocks does not ship a registry URL. See schemas/content-registry-index.md. Download size cap in this schema matches REGISTRY_MAX_PACK_BYTES (2097152) in src/renderer/content-registry.ts. The runtime parser also refuses a downloadUrl that is not https or file, and checks that publicKey and sig are raw ed25519 lengths.

id.description: Same id the pack file declares, and the directory name under ~/.chipblocks/libraries/.

version.description: Must equal the pack file's packVersion string. Compared as text, not guessed.

downloadUrl.description: https pack file. file:// is for a local test or dev index only.

size.description: Exact byte length of the downloaded file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact downloaded bytes, hex. Compared case-insensitively.

signature.description: Must match the ed25519 signature object inside the pack file. Verified over the canonical pack body (integrity and signature fields removed) before anything is written into the packs directory.
